jacques-marie-mage-jg16h.title: Jagger, Decade Collection (Roma)
jacques-marie-mage-jg16h.story: Jacques Marie Mage Decade Collection: Jagger in Roma (JMMJG-16H). An oversized late-'70s aviator with a sculptural Art Deco double bridge, in moon-gold beta titanium with silver accents, 6mm titanium lens-rim inserts, extended eye shields with sculptural cut-outs and hand-painted epoxy tailfin temple tips. Limited edition, handmade in Japan.

jacques-marie-mage-bdi-010yi.title: Borodino, 10 Year Anniversary Edition
jacques-marie-mage-bdi-010yi.story: Jacques Marie Mage Borodino, 10 Year Anniversary Edition. Bold rectangular acetate in black with polished beta-titanium hardware and the signature arrowhead temple tips. Number 31 of 150.
